definition: The append-only, hash-linked log of a game: every play, interrupt, resolve and score, each pointing to the hash of the record before it.
does: Lets anyone re-check that the game followed the resolution order and replay it.
does_not: Does not change play; a game is legal or not regardless of the log.

contrast.line: The Line shows the cards; provenance shows order, who interrupted what, and the score after each step.
contrast.resolution_order: The order is the rule; provenance is the evidence.
